basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Records how a defined value stream is actually delivered, not the stream definition itself.
Pins one stream revision and binds each stage to the processes, capabilities or systems that realize it.
Records realization gaps explicitly instead of hiding missing realizers.
Leaves dependency edges and impact analysis to their own models.

may: Bind stage realizers based on cited evidence.
Record a gap where no realizer is evidenced.
Supersede a realization when the stream revision or realizers change.
mustNot: Change the value stream definition through a realization record.
Fill unknown evidence with success or zero.
Edit a published realization version in place.
Claim ownership of the processes, systems or organisations it references.
requiresHuman: Approving a realization as the official current state.
Retiring a realization still used in planning or investment decisions.

considerations: Gap records can be read as blame for teams; they should describe delivery, not judge people.
Investment and restructuring decisions based on wrong realizations can affect jobs.
affectedParties: Teams and staff who perform the stages

items: A realization names a pinned value stream revision, a scope, an owner and stage-to-realizer bindings.
It is confused with the value stream definition, a process model or a capability map.
Decisions based on outdated realizations after systems change.
Hidden gaps when unknown evidence is shown as covered.
